title: Name a failure with attempt as
objective: Give a failure its own name with attempt ... as, so the message says which step failed.

body.text: attempt ... if it fails then gives the failure the name problem. When a program handles several failures, the name problem is not very clear. Write attempt ... as followed by a name of your choice, such as math problem. The name holds the reason, and the lines after the attempt run only when the call failed.

body.title: Name the failure
body.code:
function divide
    takes number called top
    takes number called bottom
    returns a decimal
    can fail
    if bottom is equal to 0
        fail with "cannot divide by zero"
    gives back top divided by bottom

attempt divide 10 and 0 as math problem
    say "Math failed: {math problem}"
otherwise
    say "ok"
expected: Math failed: cannot divide by zero

body.text: The otherwise branch still runs when the call works, and the result is in result. You can use a different name for each attempt, so each failure can be reported separately.

body.title: Two attempts, two names
body.code:
function connect
    takes text called address
    returns text
    can fail
    fail with "no route"

function divide
    takes number called top
    takes number called bottom
    returns a decimal
    can fail
    if bottom is equal to 0
        fail with "cannot divide by zero"
    gives back top divided by bottom

attempt connect "x" as network problem
    say "Network error: {network problem}"
otherwise
    say "ok"
attempt divide 10 and 0 as math problem
    say "Math failed: {math problem}"
otherwise
    say "ok"
expected: Math failed: cannot divide by zero

body.prompt: The program handles the failure with the plain name problem and prints only the reason. Give the failure its own name and report it as Math error: followed by the reason, so the program prints Math error: cannot divide by zero.
body.starter:
function divide
    takes number called top

    returns a decimal
    can fail
    if bottom is equal to 0
        fail with "cannot divide by zero"
    gives back top divided by bottom

attempt divide 10 and 0 if it fails then
    say problem
otherwise
    say result
